 Order
% 06.04.2026
1.

Petitioner seeks quashing of case FIR No. 198/2024 of PS Shahdara for offence under Section 498A/313/506/34 IPC.
2.

At the outset, learned counsel for petitioner seeks permission to withdraw this petition with liberty to file afresh, seeking quashment of the chargesheet, which has been filed during pendency of this petition.
3. As requested, the petition and accompanying application are dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as sought.
Date given earlier i.e., 19.05.2026 stands cancelled.
